text: During a Christmas party, an unseen man climbs into the attic of a sorority house, and soon the phone fills with [obscene calls in strange voices|rules|how it hunts] raving about someone named Billy. Upstairs, [the sisters are killed one by one|who_suffers|teenagers and young adults] while carolers sing at the door and the police shrug off the missing. Jess, pregnant and fighting with her boyfriend, learns that [the calls are coming from inside the house|trigger|an outsider reaches in]. Long after the police leave, [the attic hatch still opens|ending|the evil lives on].
